title: Compatibility of signed tensor shifts with normalized reindexing
statement: theorem podReindexingTensorSignedShiftCompatibility {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g] [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)] [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)] (D : PodCompletionReindex l E g) (hD : PodCompletionReindex.Laws l E g D) (T : PodCompletedTensorReindex l E g D) (hT : PodCompletedTensorReindex.Laws l E g D T) (SY : PodTensorSignedShift l E Y) (SX : PodTensorSignedShift l E X) (hSYg : SY.Generators l E) (hSXg : SX.Generators l E) (hSYm : SY.Model l E D.shiftSource) (hSXm : SX.Model l E D.shiftTarget) : NatTrans.CommShift D.reduction.hom ℤ ∧ NatTrans.CommShift D.limit.hom ℤ ∧ PodLimitSignedShift l E Y D.sourceRoos D.shiftSource ∧ PodLimitSignedShift l E X D.targetRoos D.shiftTarget

source.place: Steps 1 and 5; reduction, limit, and Roos compatibility.

proof.text: Use the quotient generator equation and the two-coordinate Roos comparison. The first coordinate is the projection-defined product comparison and the second receives (-1)^r. The Roos shift law in hD and the representative-model equations descend the equations through localization, yielding CommShift for reduction and limit and both PodLimitSignedShift laws.
